My level 2 half-elf sorceror died a terrible death today. Unfortunately rather than drag my body back to town for ressurection, my party members failed their Insight rolls and tossed me into a nearby mysteriously glowing circle because they didn't know what it was.

Before I give up and roll a new character, can anyone think of a way to return my undead character to the living, repair my cut vocal cords, or gain a non-verbal form of communication? I'm going to assume that you're playing 5th edition, but the rules may be different for other editions.

Bringing someone back from the dead has several spells, but the only one that will work on your character as undead is the true resurrection spell, which is a 9th level spell. at 2nd level, I'm not sure your friends will have contact with a high level druid or cleric who could perform this for you, but perhaps if you insist on bringing the character back, your DM could work on a quest for them to find someone who would be willing.

I would probably try to advise them on bringing you in to a city to a temple, as the sight of an adventuring party with an undead creature might have the townsfolk run you out of town or burn your corpse.

However, True Resurrection can provide you a new body even if your old one is totally destroyed, so you have that going for you. It's just that the material components are 25,000 gold worth of diamonds that are consumed, so this probably won't be an easy task.

Best of luck with your new undead life. As my old group liked to say, don't be undead when you can be fundead! Make the most of your new un-life!

You permanently lose one sorcery point from your pool and only gain one Metamagic option when you hit level 3. In return, you permanently have the Subtle Spell metamagic active and it can now be combined with any Metamagic type.

In addition, you replace one of your existing cantrips as Message.
